Martin Beck presents at VISSOFT 2011

Martin Beck, member of our Computer Graphics Systems group and member of the HPI Research School, is contributing to the 6th IEEE International Workshop on Visualizing Software for Understanding and Analysis (VISSOFT 2011). He is presenting a paper on “A Visual Analysis and Design Tool for Planning Software Reengineerings”, which was authored by him, Jonas Trümper, and Jürgen Döllner. This year’s VISSOFT is co-located with ICSM 2011 and is held in Williamsburg, Virginia (USA), on September 29-30, 2011.
